headline: GM trims 500-600 IT jobs, with AI one factor
body: A quiet day with one small story. General Motors cut 500 to 600 roles, mostly in IT, and a person familiar told CNBC that AI played a part, though not the only one. That is a slight hit to Shared Prosperity, so Egalitarian Utopia dipped. Older stories kept fading by hundredths. Horizon Balance reads +1.93.
movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia -0.1 from GM's IT job cuts (-0.06); Gatekeeper and Reversion each slipped 0.01 from fading.
